description: Where visitors whose first touch was an AI assistant (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and others) land on one website, and how each page converts them (signed up or paid within 30 days) against everyone on that page and against the site. Per assistant and per page; money per currency. verdict is leak (under half the site rate, chance under 5%), below, on_par, above, or too_few (under 20 assistant visitors or under 3 conversions expected). Quote verdict and chance; do not call a too_few page a leak. Same from/to/time_zone/currency as analytics_snapshot.

from.description: inclusive start YYYY-MM-DD; default last 60 days

period.description: named window instead of from/to: today, yesterday, 7d, 28d, 30d, 90d, 365d (each ends today), this_month, or last_month

website_id.description: website id (uuid) or the site domain (example.com); omit when the account has one website

name: ai_landings
title: AI landings
